detect: ^Compare file sync methods using one 8kB write:
parser:
import re

PER_TEST = re.compile(r"^(?P<value>\d+ seconds?) per test\s*$")
ODIRECT = re.compile(r"^O_DIRECT (?P<value>.*?)\.?\s*$")
TITLE = re.compile(r"^(?P<title>\S.*?):\s*$")
ROW = re.compile(r"^\s+(?P<test>\S(?:.*?\S)?)\s{2,}(?P<ops>[\d.]+|n/a)(?P<star>\*)?(?: ops/sec\s+(?P<usecs>\d+) usecs/op)?\s*$")
FOOT = re.compile(r"^\*\s*(?P<text>.*?)\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    config, config_lines, rows, row_lines = {}, [], [], []
    section, note, in_note = "", [], False
    starred, foot, in_foot = [], [], False
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            in_foot = False
            continue
        m = PER_TEST.match(ln)
        if m:
            config["time per test"] = m.group("value"); config_lines.append(i); continue
        m = ODIRECT.match(ln)
        if m:
            config["O_DIRECT"] = m.group("value"); config_lines.append(i); continue
        m = ROW.match(ln)
        if m:
            in_note = False
            in_foot = False
            r = {"section": section, "note": " ".join(note), "test": m.group("test"),
                 "ops/sec": m.group("ops"), "usecs/op": m.group("usecs") or "", "footnote": ""}
            rows.append(r)
            if m.group("star"):
                starred.append(r)
            row_lines.append(i); continue
        m = FOOT.match(ln)
        if m:
            foot = [m.group("text")]; in_foot = True
            for r in starred:
                r["footnote"] = " ".join(foot)
            row_lines.append(i); continue
        if in_foot and ln[:1].isspace():
            foot.append(ln.strip())
            for r in starred:
                r["footnote"] = " ".join(foot)
            row_lines.append(i); continue
        m = TITLE.match(ln)
        if m and not ln.startswith("("):
            section, note, in_note = m.group("title"), [], False
            starred, in_foot = [], False
            row_lines.append(i); continue
        if ln.startswith("(") or in_note:
            text = ln.strip()
            in_note = not text.endswith(")")
            note.append(text.strip("()")); row_lines.append(i); continue
    blocks = [{"name": "config", "kind": "kv", "lines": config_lines, "records": [config]},
              {"name": "sync methods", "kind": "table", "lines": row_lines, "records": rows}]
    return blocks
